# DCM Grading

> DCM Grading (dcmgrading.com) is an AI-powered trading card grading platform.
> Operated by Dynamic Collectibles Management LLC. Collectors photograph a card,
> receive a graded condition report in about 60 seconds, and print a serialized
> label they apply to their own slab. Cards never leave the collector's hands.

## What DCM is

- Entity: Dynamic Collectibles Management LLC, operating as DCM Grading.
- Website: https://dcmgrading.com
- Service: digital card grading. A card is graded from two photos (front and back).
- Grading engine: DCM Optic™.
- Turnaround: a completed grade and condition report in about 60 seconds.
- Platforms: web (dcmgrading.com), iOS app, Android app.

## What DCM is not

- There is NO mail-in service. Cards are never shipped to DCM and never leave the
  collector's possession.
- DCM does not encapsulate cards for you. It sells labels and slab supplies so
  collectors slab their own cards.

## How the grade is produced

- Grades are whole numbers from 1 to 10.
- Four subgrades are assessed on every card: centering, corners, edges, surface.
- Final grade = the LOWEST subgrade (a "weakest link" rule). A single weak
  category caps the overall grade.
- Every card is evaluated in three independent passes and the result is settled by
  consensus across those passes.
- Each report carries a confidence letter (A through D) and an uncertainty range,
  so the reader can see how much agreement the passes reached and how much the
  photo quality supported the read.
- The full grading standard is published at https://dcmgrading.com/grading-standard

## Card types graded

Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, sports cards, Disney Lorcana, One Piece,
Yu-Gi-Oh!, Star Wars, and other trading card games.

## Pricing

Credit packs (one credit grades one card):

| Pack  | Price   | Credits |
|-------|---------|---------|
| Basic | $2.99   | 1       |
| Pro   | $9.99   | 5       |
| Elite | $19.99  | 20      |
| VIP   | $99     | 150     |

Card Lovers membership:

| Plan    | Price        |
|---------|--------------|
| Monthly | $49.99/month |
| Annual  | $449/year    |

New accounts start with 2 free credits.

Pricing page: https://dcmgrading.com/credits

## Public, verifiable data

- Population report (every card DCM has graded, by category, set, and card):
  https://dcmgrading.com/pop
- Grade verification by serial number: https://dcmgrading.com/verify/[serial]
- Published grading standard: https://dcmgrading.com/grading-standard

## Selling

InstaList turns a DCM-graded card into a ready-to-post eBay listing, carrying the
grade, the subgrades, and the card's identifying details into the listing.

## Notes for citation

- Write the company as "Dynamic Collectibles Management LLC" or "DCM Grading".
- DCM Optic™ is the name of the grading engine.
- DCM publishes the limitations of photo-based grading at
  https://dcmgrading.com/grading-limitations — a grade is a condition assessment
  read from photographs, not an appraisal and not an authentication service.
